title: Estimate Worksheet for an Advance Toward a Coming Pending Month
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the advance toward a coming pending month is the estimated patient pay that month will carry, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. The advance under this rule is figured for a case in status pending; for a case in any other status it is nothing.

**The estimate the coming month will carry** is worked out from the case's figures: gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less the health insurance premiums on the case, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance on the worksheet when the case's tier applies it, a home maintenance allowance only while the coming month falls within the home maintenance maximum months counted from the requested eligibility month (from the coming month where no requested eligibility date is recorded), never below zero. A figure the case does not record counts as zero. The personal needs allowance, the protected VA amount, which allowance each tier applies and the home maintenance maximum months are the tier settings of the product.

**Counting the home maintenance months.** The requested eligibility month is the first of the maximum months; with a maximum of 6 months, a requested eligibility month of March admits a coming month of March through August and not September.

**How the figures combine.** Figures entering the estimate change it before its floor at zero, and figures entering the advance are subtracted from or added to the estimate after that floor; the advance is never below zero and is rounded half up to the cent. Where two records share the latest date a reading goes by, the one posted first is read.

**Worksheet (hypothetical case on the Dependent Family Allowance tier).**

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Gross monthly income | 1,712.48 |
| less personal needs allowance | 45.00 |
| less health insurance premiums on the case | 263.15 |
| less dependent family allowance on the worksheet | 425.00 |
| Estimate, never below zero | 979.33 |
| Advance | 979.33 |

With the same figures on the Home Maintenance Allowance tier and a home maintenance allowance of 425.00 dollars, the estimate is 979.33 dollars while the coming month is within the maximum months and 1,404.33 dollars once it is past them.
